title: When the Witness Turns Again
author: Isandro Kavanagh
blurb: Silas Amberdale, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
